nodes.speaker: character-commander
nodes.line: A dozen turf roofs around a well, and every door shut. Grey paint on every wall where the colour used to be.

nodes.speaker: class-knight
nodes.line: The Captain's Tithe Collector takes the colour every month now. Paint, cloth, flowers, anything bright. He says the Choir needs it.

nodes.speaker: class-cleric
nodes.line: He's holding a Red Mage at the toll bridge. She wouldn't pay, and he wants the whole hamlet to see what that costs.

nodes.speaker: character-merchant
nodes.line: If you're going to that bridge, I've one Healing Potion left. Take it. I'd rather it went your way than his.

nodes.speaker: class-knight
nodes.line: One potion. Give it to whoever stands in front. That's me.
